_comment: Curated news items related to tracked instruments. Add new entries by appending to the 'items' array. Newest items can go at the top or bottom — the site sorts by date.

_schema.headline: Short, factual headline
_schema.source: Publisher name (e.g. Business Standard, PIB, Reuters)
_schema.url: Direct link to the source article
_schema.appeals: Array of appeal IDs the item relates to. Valid: wfh, gold, fuel, oil, fert, swadeshi, travel, macro, retail

items.headline: Petrol hiked ₹3.14/L and diesel ₹3.11/L in Mumbai; biggest single-day revision since 2022
items.summary: OMCs raised petrol to ₹106.68/L and diesel to ₹93.14/L in Mumbai to partially offset mounting under-recoveries driven by Brent crude above $100 and a weak rupee.

items.headline: Commercial LPG 19kg cylinder hiked ₹993 to ₹3,024 in Mumbai
items.summary: Third commercial LPG hike since February; driven by a 44% jump in Saudi Contract Price and Hormuz supply disruptions. Domestic 14.2kg cylinder price unchanged at ₹912.50.

items.headline: PM Modi makes seven appeals to citizens under 'Nation First, Duty Above Comfort'
items.summary: Speech in Hyderabad framing seven citizen-led measures to conserve foreign exchange amid West Asia crisis and elevated crude prices.

items.headline: Government raises petrol and diesel prices by ₹3/litre
items.summary: OMCs implement a ₹3/litre hike to partially offset under-recoveries. Analysts flag inflation and FPI-flow risks from further hikes.

items.headline: FPI outflows from Indian equities cross ₹2.2 trillion YTD
items.summary: Foreign portfolio outflows for 2026 surpass entire CY2025 outflow of ₹1.66 trillion, contributing to rupee weakness.

items.headline: April CPI prints at 3.48%, within RBI tolerance band
items.summary: Headline inflation contained but inflationary expectations rising amid fuel and commodity pressures.
